name: Expo Engineering and Projects Limited
about: Expo Engineering and Projects Limited, an integrated engineering and construction company, engages in the manufacture and sale of process plant equipment in India. The company offers a range of process plant equipment, such as high-pressure vessels, heat exchangers, reactors, columns, and custom-built fabrications. Its on-site engineering projects include site constructions, floating roof tanks, Horton spheres, column internals and revamp, and bullets-mounded storage and above ground bullets. The company also provides maintenance shut down/revamps, as well as fabrication and erection of equipment services. It serves the green hydrogen, chemicals, power, refineries, pharmaceuticals, steel, LNG, petrochemicals, and fertilizer industries. The company was formerly known as Expo Gas Containers Ltd and changed its name to Expo Engineering and Projects Limited in June 2025. Expo Engineering and Projects Limited was incorporated in 1982 and is headquartered in Mumbai, India.
